title: Conversation 2026-11-06: multi-user, federated, fractal long-term memory

sections.name: summary
sections.label: Summary
sections.content: Started from an outside project about family context, and moved to what the owner is mainly interested in: a group of people safely managing a shared long-term agent context. Encryption and access control are a layer above SRS across repositories; signed writes, and split and merge with a recorded home, are the parts SRS itself may need. The findings are in the Research thread Shared long-term memory.
